title: Exploring Environmental Policies to Foster Industrial Waste Heat Recovery in Indonesia’s Steel Manufacturing Sector: A Case Study Based on South Korea
summary: Examined the potential for industrial waste heat recovery in Indonesia’s steel manufacturing sector and analysed South Korea’s experience in promoting industrial symbiosis. The study found that market-based incentives and voluntary information-sharing approaches, supported by environmental standards, can encourage industry adoption more effectively than a purely top-down regulatory approach. It proposed policy measures including financial incentives, regional waste heat recovery centres, technical assistance, feasibility studies, and knowledge-sharing of successful projects.

title: Developing Sustainable Industrialization Policies to Support Indonesia’s G20 Presidency Priorities: Energy Transition
summary: Analysed how Indonesia could integrate sustainable industrialization into its National Industry Development Master Plan to support the G20 energy transition agenda. The study identified key implementation challenges and proposed policy measures including carbon pricing, support for green technologies, and the adoption of Korea’s industrial symbiosis model to reduce industrial emissions while maintaining economic growth.

title: Global Political Power Shifting: from Oil to Renewable Energy
summary: The global energy landscape is currently undergoing a transformative shift towards cleaner and more sustainable energy sources. In this transition, countries that have traditionally depended heavily on exporting and importing fossil fuels are now taking the lead in the race toward clean energy. The transition to renewable energy has had a profound impact on oil-producing countries, prompting them to diversify their economies and invest in renewable energy and somehow keep for themselves the power in the global energy market. Moreover, countries with significant renewable energy capacity have the potential to emerge as leaders in this field, thereby exerting political power and influence.
